PA-MRI-LUMBAR.title: MRI Lumbar Spine - Medical Necessity

required_conditions.text: At least 6 weeks of conservative therapy (PT, NSAIDs, or activity modification) documented.
Persistent or progressive radicular pain, neurologic deficit, or red-flag findings.

exclusions: Uncomplicated acute low back pain under 6 weeks without red flags.
Repeat MRI within 12 months without a clinical change.
evidence_requirements: Dates and duration of conservative care.
Neurologic exam findings or imaging red flags.

PA-KNEE-SCOPE.title: Knee Arthroscopy with Meniscectomy - Medical Necessity

required_conditions.text: Mechanical symptoms (locking, catching, giving way) persisting despite conservative care.
MRI or exam findings consistent with a meniscal tear.

exclusions: Isolated degenerative osteoarthritis without mechanical symptoms.
No trial of physical therapy in the prior 3 months.
evidence_requirements: Imaging report describing the meniscal tear.

PA-AFLIBERCEPT.title: Aflibercept Intravitreal Injection - Medical Necessity

required_conditions.text: Diagnosis of neovascular AMD, DME, or macular edema following retinal vein occlusion.
OCT or fluorescein angiography confirming active disease.

exclusions: Use for an indication outside the approved retinal conditions.
evidence_requirements: Prior anti-VEGF agents tried and response, if any.

PA-PSG.title: Attended Polysomnography - Medical Necessity

required_conditions.text: Signs and symptoms of obstructive sleep apnea (habitual snoring, witnessed apneas, excessive daytime sleepiness).
A validated screening tool (e.g. STOP-BANG or Epworth) supports moderate-to-high pretest probability, OR a comorbidity that makes home testing unreliable.

exclusions: Home sleep apnea testing is appropriate and no disqualifying comorbidity exists.
Repeat study within 12 months without a change in therapy or weight.
evidence_requirements: Narrative of symptoms and any relevant cardiopulmonary or neuromuscular comorbidity.

PA-EGD.title: Upper GI Endoscopy with Biopsy - Medical Necessity

required_conditions.text: Alarm features (dysphagia, GI bleeding, unintentional weight loss, anemia) OR dyspepsia refractory to 4-8 weeks of PPI therapy.
Age and risk profile consistent with society guidance for diagnostic endoscopy.

exclusions: Uninvestigated dyspepsia under age 60 without alarm features and without a PPI trial.
evidence_requirements: List of alarm features or the PPI trial dates and outcome.
Relevant labs (CBC, iron studies) if anemia is cited.

PA-TFESI.title: Lumbar Transforaminal Epidural Steroid Injection - Medical Necessity

required_conditions.text: Radicular pain in a dermatomal distribution correlating with imaging-confirmed nerve root compression.
At least 4 weeks of conservative therapy without adequate relief.

exclusions: More than 3 injections at the same level within a rolling 12 months.
evidence_requirements: Imaging report localizing the compressed nerve root.
Pain scores before and after conservative therapy.
